symptom.disease_name: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features

sampled_features.disease_name: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features

additional_requirements: delusions_and_hallucinations occur exclusively during the manic episode

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.

subtypes.Auditory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of hearing voices or sounds when there is no actual sound.
subtypes.Visual Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of seeing people or objects that do not exist.
subtypes.Tactile Hallucinations: Experiencing the sensation of being touched or movement on the skin when there is no actual stimulus.
subtypes.Olfactory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of smelling odors that do not exist.
subtypes.Gustatory Hallucinations: The perceptual experience of tasting flavors that are not actually present.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.

subtypes.Depressed Mood: A persistently sunken mood or feeling of depression.
subtypes.Tearfulness: A state of frequent crying or inability to hold back tears.
subtypes.Sadness: A state where a sad or gloomy mood is maintained continuously.
subtypes.Emptiness: A feeling of inner emptiness or a state of feeling no emotion.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where emotions feel dulled or paralyzed.

S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.

subtypes.Loss of Interest: Reduced interest in previously enjoyed hobbies or leisure activities.
subtypes.Social Withdrawal: Reduced interest or effort in social interactions and maintaining relationships.
subtypes.Loss of Motivation: Lack of motivation to initiate or complete work or tasks.
subtypes.Anhedonia: Inability to experience positive emotions such as happiness, satisfaction, love, or pleasure.
subtypes.Indifference to Achievement: Insensitivity or indifference to personal achievements or success.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.

subtypes.Significant Weight Loss: Weight loss of more than 5% in a month without dieting.
subtypes.Weight Gain: Weight gain of more than 5% in a month.
subtypes.Decrease in Appetite: Decrease in appetite occurring nearly every day.
subtypes.Increase in Appetite: Increase in appetite occurring nearly every day.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S032.name: Death_Suicide
S032.description: Recurrent thoughts of death, recurrent suicidal ideation, or a suicide attempt.

subtypes.Recurrent Thoughts of Death: Passive wish to die (e.g., 'I wish I wouldn't wake up') without active intent to kill oneself.
subtypes.Suicidal Ideation: Recurring thoughts of 'I want to die' or 'I want to kill myself' without a specific plan.
subtypes.Suicidal Impulse: Strong, sudden urges to jump from a height or run into traffic without a concrete plan.
subtypes.Specific Plan for Suicide: Conceiving specific scenarios or methods regarding when, where, and how to die.
subtypes.Suicide Attempt: Actual actions taken to end one's life or preparatory behaviors like hoarding pills or writing a will.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.

subtypes.Elevated Mood: A mood that is abnormally high, euphoric, and full of unmotivated happiness and vitality.
subtypes.Irritable Mood: A state where one gets angry or aggressive even at minor stimuli.
subtypes.Mood Lability: Rapid shifts in mood, alternating unpredictably between euphoria and irritability.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.

subtypes.Increased Energy: Overflowing physical and mental energy, leading to an inability to stay still and a desire to keep moving.
subtypes.Hyperactivity: Doing far more work than usual or starting multiple activities simultaneously.
subtypes.Psychomotor Agitation: Inability to tolerate resting or stopping, driven by a constant need to do something.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).

subtypes.Inflated Self-Confidence: Feeling capable of anything and believing that failure is impossible, unlike one's usual self.
subtypes.Overestimation of Abilities: Unrealistically assessing one's talents, knowledge, or abilities as superior.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one is a special and important person with a special mission or purpose.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).

subtypes.Reduced Sleep Duration: Sleeping significantly less than usual but feeling refreshed rather than tired.
subtypes.Loss of Sleep Need: Not feeling the urge to sleep or the thought that sleep is necessary.
subtypes.Indifference to Insomnia: Feeling no problem and continuing activities despite staying up for several nights.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.

subtypes.Talkativeness: Speaking far more than usual and continuing to talk without rest.
subtypes.Rapid Speech: Speech speed is so fast that it is difficult for others to understand or interrupt.
subtypes.Pressured Speech: Cannot stop talking or tolerate silence due to an internal pressure to keep speaking.

S038.name: Racing_Thoughts
S038.description: Flight of ideas or subjective experience that thoughts are racing.

subtypes.Racing Thoughts: Thoughts spinning too fast in the head, constantly jumping from one idea to another.
subtypes.Flooding of Thoughts: Too many thoughts emerging simultaneously, making them disorganized.
subtypes.Inability to Control Thoughts: Unable to stop or slow down thoughts and unable to calm the mind.

symptom.disease_info: Bipolar I Disorder with Psychotic Features is characterized by at least one full manic episode, often alternating with major depressive episodes, where mood disturbance and changes in energy and activity cause marked impairment or require hospitalization. Manic episodes may include elevated or irritable mood, decreased need for sleep, increased goal-directed activity, and inflated self-esteem or grandiosity, sometimes accompanied by delusions or hallucinations that are typically mood-congruent. Depressive episodes feature persistent low mood and loss of interest, along with biological and cognitive changes, and can be severe, including suicidal ideation. It is distinguished from Bipolar II by the presence of full mania rather than hypomania, and from primary psychotic disorders by the temporal relationship between mood episodes and psychotic symptoms and the persistence of mood symptoms between psychotic breaks.

patient.personality: Juan is a sociable, hands-on craftsman who thrives on practical problem-solving, community involvement, and creative metalwork projects.
patient.stressor: In the months leading up to his first clear manic episode, Juan’s shop took on a major new contract that required long hours, tight deadlines, and constant troubleshooting, and he felt personally responsible for keeping the bilingual crew motivated and the client satisfied. He began volunteering for extra shifts, staying late to work on side metal art commissions, and taking on more leadership in community events, leaving him with very little rest and increasing pressure to perform perfectly at work and in the neighborhood. As the weeks went on, this constant overextension and the praise he received for “pulling miracles out of thin air” fed into a growing sense that only he could solve the shop’s problems and that he was destined to expand his work into something far bigger than the job itself, leading to increasingly unrealistic plans and conflicts with supervisors and family over his decisions. The situation escalated when his work quality and reliability started to slip, he clashed with management over safety and project scope, and his family noticed a striking change in his sense of judgment and priorities, prompting his wife and adult children to insist he see a psychiatrist after his behavior jeopardized both the contract and his standing in the community.
patient.chief_complaint: “I’m realizing now that I started to feel like I was the only one capable of running the whole shop and that I was meant for something much bigger than everyone else seemed to understand.”

S020.name: Hallucinations
S020.description: Perception-like experiences that occur without an external stimulus and are as vivid and clear as normal perception.
S020.manifestation: When I was really revved up, I kept hearing this deep male voice, kind of like a foreman or pastor, telling me in Spanish and English that I’d been chosen for a special mission to ‘reshape the city in steel,’ even when I was alone in the shop with all the machines turned off, and it felt as real as if someone was standing right next to me talking into my ear.

S024.name: Depressed_Mood
S024.description: A state where a sad, empty, or hopeless mood persists.
S024.manifestation: After that high wore off, it’s like someone flipped a switch and for months I’ve just felt this heavy, gray sadness sitting on my chest all day, where even simple things like my grandkids laughing or my wife making my favorite food don’t touch it and I just feel useless and ashamed of what I did at work.

S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.
S025.manifestation: I used to live for tinkering on my metal art in the garage or grilling with the neighbors after church, but lately I just stare at the tools or ignore the invitations, because nothing feels fun anymore and I honestly don’t see the point of starting anything when I’m convinced I’ll just screw it up or leave it half done.

S026.name: Weight_Appetite_Change
S026.description: Significant increase or decrease in appetite or weight.
S026.manifestation: During that busy time at the shop I was barely eating, just running on coffee and maybe a bite of whatever was around because I felt too wired to be hungry, and then once I crashed I swung the other way and started picking at food or skipping meals altogether, dropping enough weight that my pants started slipping off and my wife kept asking if I was sick.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.
S027.manifestation: For weeks when I was on that upswing I’d be up most of the night pacing the house or sketching out huge business plans on scrap paper, feeling wide awake and annoyed if anyone suggested I lie down, and now on the downside I stay in bed for long stretches but the sleep is choppy and I wake up exhausted, like my body and mind never really shut off.

S032.name: Death_Suicide
S032.description: Recurrent thoughts of death, recurrent suicidal ideation, or a suicide attempt.
S032.manifestation: Since everything blew up at the shop, I keep catching myself thinking it would be easier for everyone if I just didn’t wake up, and on the worst days I’ve stood in the garage looking at my welding torch and the pill bottles in the bathroom, imagining different ways to end it, even though I haven’t actually done anything yet because I picture my wife finding me and that stops me for the moment.

S033.name: Elevated_Irritable_Mood
S033.description: A distinct period of abnormally and persistently elevated, expansive, or irritable mood.
S033.manifestation: At first I felt incredible, like I was on top of the world and everything I touched at the shop was turning to gold, but if anyone questioned me—even over something small like a safety form—I’d snap at them or start yelling because they were ‘slowing down the vision,’ and my mood would flip from overly friendly to furious in seconds.

S034.name: Increased_Activity
S034.description: Abnormally and persistently increased goal-directed activity or energy.
S034.manifestation: I was running around like a machine, taking extra shifts, reorganizing the whole shop layout, signing up to help at three different community events, and then coming home to start new metal sculptures at midnight, never sitting still and getting angry if anyone tried to make me stop or take a break.

S035.name: Inflated_Self_Esteem
S035.description: Inflated self-esteem or grandiosity (may range from uncritical self-confidence to delusional proportions).
S035.manifestation: I honestly started believing I was the only person in the whole company who could save this contract and that I was meant to build some kind of famous metalworks empire—like people would study my designs in colleges someday—so I brushed off my boss’s orders and my family’s worries because I was sure they just couldn’t see how special my ideas were.

S036.name: Decreased_Sleep
S036.description: Decreased need for sleep (e.g., feels rested after only 3 hours of sleep).
S036.manifestation: For that stretch before everything fell apart, I was sleeping maybe two or three hours a night—sometimes not at all—and still waking up buzzing with energy, telling my wife I didn’t need sleep because my mind was finally working at the speed it was meant to and it would be a waste to shut it down.

S037.name: Pressured_Speech
S037.description: More talkative than usual or pressure to keep talking.
S037.manifestation: My talking got so out of control that at work and at home I’d jump from explaining a welding fix to pitching a new business idea to telling a story from my childhood without taking a breath, and people would try to cut in but I felt this pressure in my chest to keep going, like if I stopped talking the whole plan in my head would fall apart.

S038.name: Racing_Thoughts
S038.description: Flight of ideas or subjective experience that thoughts are racing.
S038.manifestation: Inside my head it felt like ten radios were all playing at once, with ideas about new products, how to fix the contract, how to redesign the whole neighborhood out of steel, and even how to ‘change the world,’ all racing so fast that I couldn’t hold onto one thought before the next one crashed in, no matter how hard I tried to slow it down.
